rules.name: parent-lots-04-legacy-user-writes-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT DATE(d.version_timestamp) AS day, d.market_action, d.version_comments, count(*) AS tickets, count(DISTINCT d.parent_trade_id) AS parents, min(d.version_timestamp) AS first_at, max(d.version_timestamp) AS last_at FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date GROUP BY DATE(d.version_timestamp), d.market_action, d.version_comments ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_cfs (inserted by the user)' AS table_changed, count(*) AS rows_found, 0 AS rows_with_zero_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs (child rows)', count(*), sum(c.active_lots = 0) FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs c ON c.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs (parent rows recalculated)', count(DISTINCT c.trade_id), count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.active_lots = 0 THEN c.trade_id END) FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs c ON c.trade_id = d.parent_trade_id WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date AND d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_active_lots_table_cfs (child rows at or after the date)', count(*), sum(a.active_lots = 0) FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id AND a.value_date >= :from_date WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_active_lots_table_cfs (parent rows at or after the date)', count(*), sum(a.active_lots = 0) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent_trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs WHERE version_created_by = :who AND version_timestamp >= :from_date AND trade_id <> parent_trade_id) p JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = p.parent_trade_id AND a.value_date >= :from_date UNION ALL SELECT 'premium_fy_table_cfs (child rows)', count(*), 0 FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.premium_fy_table_cfs p ON p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date

SELECT d.parent_trade_id, d.trade_id AS child_trade_id, d.market_action, d.original_lots AS child_lots, d.version_created_by AS who, d.version_timestamp AS at, c.active_lots AS parent_cloned_lots, (SELECT a.value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a WHERE a.trade_id = d.parent_trade_id ORDER BY a.value_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS parent_dal_value_date, (SELECT a.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a WHERE a.trade_id = d.parent_trade_id ORDER BY a.value_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS parent_dal_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs c ON c.trade_id = d.parent_trade_id WHERE d.version_created_by = :who AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date AND d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id ORDER BY d.version_timestamp, d.parent_trade_id
